sentences.text:
Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.20661 of 2009
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in not paying the compensation to the petitioners in respect of the acquired land to an extent of 1194 Square Yards situated in Nalgonda town and also to direct the respondents to notify the same under the Land Acquisition Act.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioners and the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Standing Counsel for Municipalities appearing on behalf of the respondent No.2 and perused the record.
3.

The leaned Counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioner No.1-Organization is the owner and in occupation of land to an extent of Ac.6-13 guntas in Sy.No.2 vide H.Nos.6-1-490 to 492 having purchased vide sale deed No.177/1352,F and constructed structures thereon about five years back SK,J after having obtained necessary permissions from the then Municipality, Nalgonda and the said area is covered by a compound wall and every day prayers being conducted in the Arya Samaj Hall.

While it being so, the authorities of the respondents, without intimating any land acquisition proceedings requested the then President of Arya Samaj to part with 1200 sq.Yards of land for the purpose of widening of road leading from Nalgonda to Panagal on payment of compensation as per the Land Acquisition Act.
However, without initiating any land acquisition proceedings road was laid in the subject land on promise to pay compensation.
In spite of several correspondence between the petitioners and the respondent authorities, the compensation was not paid to the petitioners.
Therefore, the petitioners filed the present writ petition seeking a direction to the respondents to initiate land acquisition proceedings and pay compensation as per the market value.

4. The learned Standing Counsel for the Municipalities basing on the counter filed by the SK,J respondent No.2, would submit that the Municipality is proposing to take action to place the matter before the council for revised proposals in respect of acquisition proposal and to get administrative sanction for payment of Rs.27.20 lakhs from Municipal funds.

5. After hearing both sides and on perusing the record, this Court is of the considered view that admittedly the respondents have acquired an extent of 1194 Sq.Yards belonging to the petitioners'
Organization without initiating any Land acquisition proceedings and without paying any compensation.
